title: Two compact opens glue the continuity property
statement: Let $X$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $U,V\subseteq X$ quasi-compact opens [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Define $C(T)$ for a scheme $T$ as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-stage-continuity]. If $C(U)$, $C(V)$ and $C(U\cap V)$ hold, then $C(U\cup V)$ holds. All these assertions quantify over every degree, every scheme and sheaf limit, and the specified comparison legs. The ambient scheme $X$ need not be quasi-compact, quasi-separated or separated.

source.place: Tag 09YQ (theorem-colimit), agent-written finite-cover reduction of the parent; Tag 0A50 (lemma-mayer-vietoris) for binary gluing.

proof.text: Fix an instance of the continuity predicate for the union. Apply lem-weil-pbc-etale-limit-cohomology-class-descent to obtain a stage representative of every element of the comparison cocone vertex. Apply lem-weil-pbc-etale-limit-binary-eventual-zero, using the specified union stage and the three continuity hypotheses, to obtain finite-stage killing of every element in the kernel of a comparison leg.

Form the canonical homomorphism kappa = colimit.desc H B. The forgetful functor from abelian groups preserves filtered colimits; shrink its preservation universes from u+1 to u as in Mathlib.Algebra.Category.Grp.FilteredColimits. Every element z of colimit H has a stage representative iota_i(x). If kappa(z)=0, the coprojection identity gives b_i(x)=0. Finite-stage killing gives f:i to j with H(f)(x)=0. Cocone naturality then gives iota_i(x)=iota_j(H(f)(x))=0. The additive kernel criterion proves kappa injective. Stage representatives of elements of B.pt prove kappa surjective by the same coprojection identity.

A bijective homomorphism of abelian groups is an isomorphism (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective). Its coprojection identity gives a cocone isomorphism from the chosen colimit cocone to B. Transport colimit.isColimit through this cocone isomorphism using IsColimit.ofIsoColimit, and package the resulting Nonempty IsColimit B as the holds field of continuity for the union.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09YQ (theorem-colimit), elementwise colimit assembly from existing class descent and the kernel half of the two-open Mayer-Vietoris reduction (Tag 0A50).
